cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je seznámit studenty se základními zootechnickými pojmy, s možnostmi hodnocení hlavních užitkových vlastností hospodářských zvířat a vysvětlení teoretických základů plemenářské práce a šlechtění hospodářských zvířat. Získané znalosti po absolutoriu daného předmětu vytvoří pro studenty základnu pro další studium speciálních zootechnických disciplín. Studenti si rozšíří dovednosti spojené s dokonalejším využíváním literárních a internetových informací. Předmět rovněž napomáhá rozšíření kapacity v oblasti biologického myšlení, spojené s využitím nových znalostí i v řadě mezioborových disciplín.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: In this course, students will learn about essential terms and concepts of animal husbandry, possibilities of evaluation of farm animal performance and theoretical principles of breeding work & selection of farm animals. After finishing this course, they will be able to use the acquired knowledge as a base for their further study of special subjects of animal science. They will extend their skills in the field of a better use of literary data and internet information. This course also should improve student's capacity in the field of biological thinking and application of acquired knowledge in some other related branches of science

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Importance of animal production within the ecological system and as a method of producing foodstuffs (allowance 1/1) a.Definition of animal science and its position within the system of biological disciplines. Environmental importance of animal breeding and production. Current situation, development, and prospects of animal breeding and animal production. Importance of and current situation in the organic linkage of plant and animal production2.Zootechnical evaluation of morphologic traits of farm animals (allowance 1/1) a.Exterior and interior of animals3.Evaluation of physiological properties of animals (allowance 1/1) a.Practical evaluation of constitution type, habitus, complexion and temperament in relation to animal species, age category, sex, and type of performance. Evaluation of condition. Expression of condition score with regard to animal reproduction4.Biological principles of fertility and milk production (allowance 1/1) a.Breeding techniques and fertility evaluation. Differences in milk production of individual animal species. Evaluation of milk production5.Biological principles of growth (allowance 1/1) a.Ontogenesis. New knowledge in the domain of growth of body tissues. Growth allometry6.Biological principles of production slaughter animals and evaluation of meat performance (allowance 1/1) a.Fattening capacity. Meatiness. Carcass value7.Biological principles of production of labour and skin derivatives (allowance 1/1) a.Labour production. Production of hides and furs. Production of wool and feathers8.Classification of methods of breeding work and requirements concerning methods of animal breeding (allowance 5/5) a.Breeding value. Principles of basic methods of selection in animal husbandry. Methods of animal breeding. Breeding programmes.
